# Code of conduct

Keep contributions and discussions useful, respectful, and focused on the project. People with different backgrounds and levels of experience are welcome.

- Discuss the behaviour and evidence, and give others room to clarify or correct a mistake.
- Respect privacy. Do not post another person's personal information or private app content.
- Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, and repeated disruptive promotion are not acceptable.

The maintainer may edit or remove disruptive content and limit participation when needed. Report abusive content through GitHub's **Report content** menu. For private project concerns, use a contact method listed on the [maintainer's profile](https://github.com/bal-r).

This applies to the repository's issues, pull requests, and other project spaces.
